blocks.content: The Lokpal shall constitute an Inquiry Wing headed by the Director of Inquiry for the purpose of conducting preliminary inquiry into any offence alleged to have been committed by a public servant.

rows: Prosecution of offenses before Special Court

items: Note that the minimum rank required for Directors of both wings is Additional Secretary to the Government of India.
The statutory time frame for completing a preliminary inquiry is 60 days, extendable by up to 60 days at a time.
Differentiate between the Inquiry Wing (preliminary inquiry) and Prosecution Wing (prosecuting before the Special Court).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Lokpal is mandated to constitute an Inquiry Wing headed by a Director of Inquiry for conducting preliminary inquiries.
The Director of Inquiry and Director of Prosecution must both hold ranks not below Additional Secretary to the Government of India.
The Prosecution Wing is responsible for filing prosecution cases against public servants in the Special Court.
A preliminary inquiry by the Inquiry Wing should ordinarily be completed within 60 days.
Lokpal may also entrust preliminary inquiry or investigation to any agency including the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI).
